concepts.title: Agent placeholder
concepts.description: Freeze boilerplate placeholder language before it slips into the repo.

concepts.title: Sample content
concepts.description: Catch copy-pasted sample content that should be replaced with real implementation.

concepts.title: Marker spam
concepts.description: Freeze marker-heavy comments that turn into slop debt when they accumulate in files.

concepts.title: Long lines
concepts.description: Freeze the readability rule that keeps long lines from becoming hard-to-review code.
examples: A long one-liner that should be wrapped or refactored.

concepts.title: Actionful buttons
concepts.description: Freeze the UI convention that every button must declare an explicit action hook.

concepts.title: Linked front-end assets
concepts.description: Freeze the convention that UI actions declared in markup must be linked from client-side handlers so the interface remains legible and reviewable.

concepts.title: Explicit button types
concepts.description: Freeze the UI convention that every button must declare its interaction intent.

concepts.title: Accessible form labels
concepts.description: Freeze the accessibility convention that every form control needs an explicit label.

concepts.title: Oversized file
concepts.description: Freeze the size guardrail that prevents giant files from becoming unreviewable.
examples: A generated or monolithic file that should be split.

concepts.title: Empty file
concepts.description: Freeze the rule that rejects empty placeholder files from making it into the tree.
examples: An empty stub file that needs content.

concepts.title: Fully defined rules
concepts.description: Freeze the policy convention that every rule must be fully explainable and traceable.
examples: A rule with description, what, why, and source_refs metadata.

concepts.title: Loadable source refs
concepts.description: Freeze the convention that every rule source reference must resolve to a readable file.
examples: A rule that points to docs/hygiene-rules.md or sbg_manifest.json.

concepts.title: Dynamic configuration
concepts.description: Freeze the convention that code and manifests should rely on runtime-derived values instead of machine-specific hard-coded paths.
examples: A config value that uses environment variables or runtime discovery instead of machine-specific values.

concepts.title: Composite hygiene idea
concepts.description: Compose several smaller checks into one higher-level idea, scoped to a set of files, combined with all/any logic.
examples: match src/**/*.py and require both long-lines and placeholder-comments to pass
logic any: a file may satisfy either of two acceptable forms
